title: Wings live: Circus-Krone-Bau, Munich | 1972
content:
Wings performed at the Circus-Krone-Bau in Munich, Germany, on 18 July 1972.

It was the fifth night of the Wings Over Europe Tour, which opened in Ollioules, France, on 9 July. They were Paul McCartney’s first European concerts since 1966.

The Beatles had performed at the Circus-Krone-Bau during their final tour on 24 June 1966. Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band played there on 13 July 2011.

Wings were Paul McCartney on vocals, guitar, and bass guitar; Linda McCartney on vocals and keyboards; Denny Laine on vocals, guitar, and bass guitar; Henry McCullough on guitar and vocals; and Denny Seiwell on drums.
